text.p: Stefanel Milan beat Olimpija Ljubljana of Slovenia 94-90 on Thursday to edge nearer a place in European club basketball's Final Four in Rome next month.
It was tough luck on the visitors' Aeriel McDonald who topscored with 28 points in a fine individual display in the quarter-final first leg.

Stefanel started strongly, leading 22-11 after 6.20 minutes, but lost Anthony Bowie on the stroke of seven minutes with a leg muscle problem. That lifted Ljubljana and by halftime they had cut the deficit to 43-40.
Stefanel's Gregor Fucka took a long time getting into a match against the club where he played as a youth but ended with 16 points.
